methods.title: Tetrahedral FCC slice-chirality gauge and face-holonomy classifier
inputs: six F2 transition bits on pairwise overlaps of four three-axis FCC slices
optional accepted P000 all-negative transition representative
outputs: canonical star-gauge representative for every even face vector
boundaries: the six overlap bits are inputs and are not derived from bare FCC incidence
slice-chirality transport is distinct from the globally coherent sign assignment on twelve oriented FCC directions
all-face-odd obstructs a global signed J but not reversal-even scalar Euler observables
no identity with unrelated C2 residuals is asserted
